subject: rstan compilation errors when using rpy2

messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: rstan compilation errors when using rpy2
parts:
Hi all, 


This is more a "if you've seen this sort of weird error before, you may twig; else disregard" sort of question. 


We are trying to compile and estimate a stan model on an EC2 machine with ubuntu 14.04.3. In the past we've done this by calling an R script directly from the command line; the script would load an Rdata file and compile/run the model. Yet the rest of our platform is in python and we'd like to call the (rstan) model from rpy2 (I'd like to keep the stan in R for checking/post-processing).


We are using R version 3.2.2, rstan version 2.9.0 and stan headers version 2.9.0. 


The interesting bit is as follows:

 - If we open up an interactive R session and run the code, it compiles and estimates seemingly perfectly.

 - But, in our case we want to automatically run the code from a python process. If we call the exact same code via rpy2, we get the following error during the model compilation:



Compilation argument:

 /usr/lib/R/bin/R CMD SHLIB filed06afa9f28.cpp 2> filed06afa9f28.cpp.err.txt

g++ -I/usr/share/R/include -DNDEBUG   -isystem"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rcpp/include/"  -isystem"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/RcppEigen/include/"  -isystem"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/RcppEigen/include/unsupported"  -isystem"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/rstan/include/boost_not_in_BH" -isystem"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/BH/include" -isystem"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/StanHeaders/include/src/"  -isystem"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/StanHeaders/include/"  -I"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/rstan/include" -DEIGEN_NO_DEBUG  -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -DEIGEN_NO_DEBUG     -fpic  -g -O2 -fstack-protector --param=ssp-buffer-size=4 -Wformat -Werror=format-security -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -g  -c filed06afa9f28.cpp -o filed06afa9f28.o


g++ -shared -L/usr/lib/R/lib -Wl,-Bsymbolic-functions -Wl,-z,relro -o filed06afa9f28.so filed06afa9f28.o -L/usr/lib/R/lib -lR

/home/deploy/.virtualenvs/venv_lendable_platform/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/rpy2/robjects/functions.py:106: UserWarning: Error in file(con, "r") : cannot open the connection


  res = super(Function, self).__call__(*new_args, **new_kwargs)

/home/deploy/.virtualenvs/venv_lendable_platform/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/rpy2/robjects/functions.py:106: UserWarning: In addition:

  res = super(Function, self).__call__(*new_args, **new_kwargs)

/home/deploy/.virtualenvs/venv_lendable_platform/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/rpy2/robjects/functions.py:106: UserWarning: Warning messages:


  res = super(Function, self).__call__(*new_args, **new_kwargs)

/home/deploy/.virtualenvs/venv_lendable_platform/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/rpy2/robjects/functions.py:106: UserWarning: 5:

  res = super(Function, self).__call__(*new_args, **new_kwargs)

/home/deploy/.virtualenvs/venv_lendable_platform/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/rpy2/robjects/functions.py:106: UserWarning: In file(con, "r") :

  res = super(Function, self).__call__(*new_args, **new_kwargs)

/home/deploy/.virtualenvs/venv_lendable_platform/local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/rpy2/robjects/functions.py:106: UserWarning:  cannot open file '/usr/lib/R/share/make/shlib.mk': No such file or directory


  res = super(Function, self).__call__(*new_args, **new_kwargs)



Cheers, 

Jim

messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: Re: rstan compilation errors when using rpy2
parts:
Just in case anyone else has the same problem, the file '/usr/lib/R/share/make/shlib.mk' for some reason didn't live at that location when called from rpy2. Symlink fixed everything. 

Thanks Bob for the pointer.
